verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible flow from product to headline to CTA, but the NEW/LIMITED RUN badges are cut off from the offer and pushed to the top-right, the glow circle sits off-centre behind the jar, and 'Swipe up to shop' has been enlarged and moved above the CTA. B puts the badges in a stray, off-axis spot at the bottom-left below the CTA and close to the edge, leaves a big dead gap between the jar and the CTA, and also moves the swipe hint above the button.

B has the badges orphaned at the bottom-left, off the centre axis and below the CTA, with a large empty gap above the button.

A's headline-first stack is clear and the badges are centred and grouped with the CTA, but they are jammed right above the button near the bottom edge, the swipe hint sits above the jar with an awkward gap, and the glow circle is off-centre. B has the same structure but drops the badges to the bottom-left corner below the CTA, breaking the centre axis and the grouping.
